deviations: First-stage F-statistic computed as the Wald F of the single excluded instrument using the historical-county clustered vcov (equivalent to Kleibergen-Paap F for one instrument); the paper does not state which F variant it reports. Non-robust first-stage F values are printed as diagnostics but not scored.
Wheat suitability control in Table 2 col 3+ and Table 3 is the binary indicator wheat_tmean <= 5, as the task context specifies.
notes: Data: replication_data.dta (325 districts). Sample: 298 districts with non-missing Domesday mills. Dependent variable wrights/pcmean, regressor mills/pcmean (per capita by mean 1710-50 population; matches Table 1 means 3.76 and 18.92). Controls: main geo = latitude, longitude, dist_rug_mean, dist_elevation_mean; agricultural = suitmean, wheat indicator, dist_grass_mean; climatic = precip_mean_dist, temp_mean_dist; other = pcmean, min_harbor, DIST_London, min_dist_to_roman_rds, min_dist_2nav_rivers, area. River suitability = riv_rug26count (river length with ruggedness 2-6); instrument = riv_rug26count x wheat indicator. OLS and 2SLS via fixest, SEs clustered by GAZ_CNTY (35 counties). attempt-1 was an exploratory data inspection with no RESULT lines. No author scripts or result files were opened.
